ruleDefinitions.name: Linux Package Uninstall
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects linux package removal using builtin tools such as "yum", "apt", "apt-get" or "dpkg".

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/yum$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*erase.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*remove.*"))) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\/apt$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/apt\\-get$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*remove.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*purge.*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/dpkg$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-remove\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-r\\ .*"))) OR (process_path = RGX("\\/rpm$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*")))
